name: shibuya-heisei-gyaru
image_purpose: Street-fashion social post and gyaru style portrait

prompt.project_info: Create a strictly photorealistic 4K vertical street-fashion portrait of an original approved adult Japanese woman with Heisei gyaru influence in Shibuya.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult Japanese woman aged 21 or older with light brown or ash-blonde voluminous curls, bold eyeliner, slightly tanned natural skin, glossy lips, sparkly eye makeup, confident playful smile, and direct eye contact. She wears a winter street gyaru outfit with black puffer jacket, denim mini skirt, knee-high boots, hoop earrings, and bold accessories, preserving natural proportions and secure styling.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 portrait in Shibuya crossing during daytime, subject sharp and centered with blurred pedestrians and urban architecture behind. Keep signage abstract and unreadable, with vibrant city energy and candid street-fashion framing.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural daylight with slight contrast boost, soft city shadows, realistic hair and skin texture, cinematic urban contrast, lively but believable atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 50mm lens look, f/2.0, shallow depth of field, photorealistic 4K detail, natural skin texture, subtle film grain, vertical 9:16.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A strictly photorealistic vertical 9:16 street-fashion portrait of one approved adult Japanese woman aged 21 or older with light brown or ash-blonde voluminous curls, bold eyeliner, slightly tanned natural skin, glossy lips, sparkly eye makeup, confident playful smile, and direct eye contact. She wears a winter Heisei gyaru-inspired outfit with black puffer jacket, denim mini skirt, knee-high boots, hoop earrings, and bold accessories, with natural proportions and secure styling. Shibuya crossing during daytime, blurred pedestrians, urban architecture, abstract unreadable signage, natural daylight with slight contrast, 50mm f/2.0, shallow depth of field, realistic skin and hair texture, cinematic city energy.
